focused_experiment.family: Only canonical vertices participating in unresolved features seed sampling. New chord endpoints must share a seed disk. Original parents outside all seed disks are fixed. All scales and caps unchanged.
focused_experiment.timing_scope: Single sample; sum of per-group times excluding loading/grouping. Soft five-second target. One 2.90-second representation check ran concurrently with part of the survey; no speedup claim.
focused_experiment.decision: Keep the focused family as an explicit research comparison, not the default reference or production integration. Smaller proposals increase city coverage but do not make bounded search reliable. Separate represented geometry from discovered solutions before changing formulation; do not raise limits or append repair fallbacks.

compact_turn_experiment.timing_scope: Single sample, sum of per-group time excluding loading/grouping, unchanged soft five-second target. No concurrent test/mesh workload in this run; timing is not a performance guarantee.

The aborted survey is excluded from timings.

compact_turn_experiment.verification: 41 focused contract/graph/topology/route tests passed in 9.74 s after the graph-identity correction. Default analytic CLI and complete focused analytic/city CLI exercised. Missing-output error path checked. Final figure is byte-identical to the inspected figure. No production or mesher change.
compact_turn_experiment.decision: Keep the compact encoding as the sole turn formulation. Focused coverage improves from 43 to 72 additional groups, retaining 42 and losing one; total time is roughly unchanged. No complete city passes. Next measure and prove removal of redundant candidate routes without changing delivered geometry or original-parent provenance; keep caps fixed.

A capped set is only its first 2001 proposals, including overflow; no cap was increased and no suffix was inferred.

All 538 proposal sets compared; only the three newly admitted models solved. No claim that time-limited solver outcomes are unchanged for identical models.
route_redundancy_experiment.decision: Keep the earlier exclusion as a budget-accounting correction. Reject broader chord splitting under the current evidence. Next compare the 44 vertex-removal successes missed by the compact route run to distinguish missing chain-replacement geometry from search limits, before another solver or sampling change.

chain_coverage_experiment.scope: 44 groups resolved with at least one edit by vertex removal and not conforming in the compact-turn route survey. Group indices are zero-based, using saved_city_groups on the source_run above. Current proposals include the subsequent early duplicate exclusion.
chain_coverage_experiment.reference_reproduction: Reran simplify_group on the same raw groups with merge_buildings=True and the same 2000-check limit. All group metrics equal the saved reference and every normalized output polygon matches its saved city artifact. All 44 reference outputs independently pass the full contract.
chain_coverage_experiment.absence_test: For each changed canonical target edge, find all sampled sites lying exactly on the segment. Overapproximate possible emissions by permitting every <=1m link between those sites, without band/seed/chord-cap restrictions, and every same-original-parent run. Undirected reachability still fails for 138 edges in 37 groups. Every missing edge in this audit has only its two endpoints on the segment, no shared original parent and length >1m. Absence holds even without proposal/model/solver work limits; it concerns the exact reference output, not all conforming alternatives.
chain_coverage_experiment.witness_test: The remaining seven targets have explicit directed assignments. Keep every sampled original route and site, retain only target-required new chords, and fix all omitted chord variables to zero. Reuse build_model plus the initial core winding rows, check binary assignment feasibility, decode with selected_regions, compare geometry with the reference, and independently check the full contract. Omitted chord rows are vacuous under zero substitution and existing binary bounds; no solver is called. For two chord-capped groups, check only required suffix chords against the existing generator predicates without generating the suffix or increasing caps. This proves uncapped family eligibility, not that the ordinary capped generator returns a graph.
chain_coverage_experiment.verification: 43 focused contract/graph/topology/route tests pass, including the new generic 5m noisy-wall witness. No full solver or meshing survey rerun; no production, candidate-generator or solver change.
chain_coverage_experiment.decision: Treat whole-boundary-chain replacement geometry as the next construction obligation. Independence radius is not a maximum replacement-edge length. Define and measure a chain-based candidate family before changing the search; preserve topology examples, parent semantics, fixed fidelity and explicit work limits. Do not inject reference outputs, stack prototype fallbacks, raise caps or infer that all 37 groups are unsolvable by the existing family.

whole_chain_experiment.execution_note: Only probe docstrings were edited after the long survey started; runtime code remained fixed. Hashes describe the final documented sources.
whole_chain_experiment.family: Original canonical vertices bound subchains whose interior vertices are unresolved-feature seeds of degree two. Stop at a nonseed, junction or full cycle. No shortcut length limit; chord must lie in original strict band and not on original boundary. New chords retain no original-parent identity. Deduplicate with local chords. No reference output is used for generation.

whole_chain_experiment.decision: Keep whole-chain geometry in the research reference: it addresses a demonstrated representation omission with bounded work. Do not claim a cleaning-quality or runtime improvement or promote it to production: 71 repairs versus 72, one gain and two losses. Before more geometric operators or solver tuning, derive and measure a smaller representation of local boundary choices, with explicit preservation obligations on known feasible witnesses. No cap increases or stacked fallback cleaners.

supported_chord_experiment.baseline: whole_chain_experiment: 71 additional conforming groups, 136 complete candidate sets, 392.16 seconds
supported_chord_experiment.rule: Remove only a new chord shorter than the existing separation threshold and lacking any third collinear site at either endpoint origin. Use exact floating cross products, all sites, and deliberately ignore direction/route availability for a conservative support test. Apply before total chord cap; preserve original-parent segments, every site, all limits and the eager-carrier experiment. No geometry substitution or new fallback.
supported_chord_experiment.proof_scope: In the current binary model such a chord forces both endpoints active, violating their separation row. Every removed direction is already zero in every feasible integer assignment, so simultaneous deletion preserves those assignments, costs and decoded geometry. This does not establish completeness relative to all contract-admissible polygons or promise identical timed solver outcomes. The unchanged separation tolerance is one private constant shared with the checker.

pre_edit_audit.scope: Four analytic examples and 44 reference groups; capped groups contribute only their observed prefix, not inferred suffixes.

construction.timing_scope: Group proposal generation only; excludes loading/grouping and includes profiling overhead on 44 reference groups. Filtering also explores longer prefixes before the same retained-chord cap.

reference_witnesses.verification: Actual model builder including initial core rows, exact target decoding and independent contract; no witnesses supplied to search. Unused chord variables fixed to zero for the witness check.

full_solver_survey.time_limit_note: Five seconds is a solver target, not a hard process deadline; calls can overrun during solver work. Limits were not increased.

supported_chord_experiment.verification: 45 focused contract/graph/topology/route tests pass. The new regression exhausts all 512 binary assignments in a small model and checks conservative collinear support and threshold equality. All known reference witnesses remain represented. Ordinary focused analytic and full fixed-city CLI completed. Production geometry is unchanged; checker tolerance only consolidated without changing its value. No mesh rerun. The ordinary example plot was inspected: point contact now uses a conforming bridge rather than the previous conforming separation, illustrating alternate solver optima. The separation witness remains represented. Formatting and whitespace checks passed.
supported_chord_experiment.decision: Keep the sound filter in the bounded research reference, but stop treating this global mixed-integer route search as the production construction direction. The 41% reduction preserves known solutions yet yields only three extra repairs with 82% more group runtime. None of the 32 newly admitted candidate sets succeeds. Next specify a constructive boundary/occupancy method with explicit original-core preservation and progress obligations before coding; retain the checker and small route model as independent references. Do not add pruning, solver tuning or stacked fallback stages to chase city counts.
